title: Egypt’s Hidden Pharaohs | Valley of the Kings
script:
Egypt buried its kings inside a mountain.

Workers carved long corridors deep into limestone.

They painted the underworld by lamplight.

Most tombs were robbed. Tutankhamun's was found largely intact.

scenes.narration: Egypt buried its kings inside a mountain.
scenes.label: Egypt’s Hidden Pharaohs | Valley of the Kings

production.visual: Hook. 9:16. Two shots: (0.0–1.5s) dramatic aerial of the Valley of the Kings and the pyramid-shaped el-Qurn mountain, bold high-contrast label "INSIDE A MOUNTAIN" in a reserved upper title zone; (1.5–3.0s) whip/push through a rock-cut tomb entrance, a torchlight flash revealing the dark corridor. Place labels in clear negative space, never on the main subject. Historically grounded New Kingdom landscape, cinematic sandstone detail, warm/cool lighting.
production.sound: Immediate low impact at frame one, short stone-whoosh into the opening. No slow logo intro; scene transition on a sharp beat.

scenes.narration: Workers carved long corridors deep into limestone.

production.visual: Three shots: (3.0–4.3s) a crew of Deir el-Medina craftsmen with copper/bronze chisels cutting rock under lamplight; (4.3–5.6s) close-up of a chisel and flying limestone dust; (5.6–7.0s) schematic tomb cutaway through limestone with a descending corridor and burial chamber, not a surveyed archaeological plan. Quick camera moves and depth parallax. On-screen label "CUT BY HAND" in the upper safe area; keep subtitles separate.
production.sound: Rhythmic chisel taps and stone grit, subtle lamp ambience, quick cut into painted walls.

scenes.narration: They painted the underworld by lamplight.

production.visual: Three shots: (7.0–8.3s) Egyptian artisan carefully painting an underground tomb wall; (8.3–9.6s) close-up of vividly painted funerary figures, hieroglyphs and mineral pigment with lamplight flicker; (9.6–11.0s) camera reveals a beautifully decorated rock-cut royal passage receding into darkness. Place "PAINTED IN DARKNESS" in negative space above the art. Preserve historical restraint; no fantasy glyphs.
production.sound: Soft brush-on-plaster, lamp flame, quick ominous drop before the reveal.

scenes.narration: Most tombs were robbed. Tutankhamun's was found largely intact.
scenes.label: Egypt’s Hidden Pharaohs | Valley of the Kings

production.visual: Two shots: (11.0–12.6s) disturbed/robbed royal burial entrance, broken seal, no graphic violence; (12.6–15.0s) atmospheric reference to Tutankhamun's discovery with a decorated coffin and a restrained gold-lit entrance, then bold end card "THE VALLEY OF THE KINGS" and "WATCH THE FULL DOCUMENTARY" with unobscured main object and subtitle-safe separation. Do not depict Tutankhamun's tomb as completely untouched; it was found largely intact relative to other royal burials. Ensure the YouTube related-video link is set to https://youtu.be/Nw6pvULzs1c after posting.
production.sound: Short stone-seal crack, silence beat, uplifting final music accent; end clearly at 15.0s.
